name: Super Rupair → Brainard Gateway
description: If you are dropping your car off in North Boulder you are obligated to go on a bike ride. Jumped from a stock 100mm stem to 130mm, much better. Turned around at the gate because I got the service text and the weather was turning FAST. Very cold descent - glad I brought all my warm stuff except for being stuck with thin shorts with holes in them. Ordered a burrito at the mountain exchange expecting to pocket it but it came out wet on a plate so I ate it in 5 bites to beat the snow. I think I can get away with just a new valve body.
